title.narrative: Updating Ukraine Regional Refugee Education Data Platform

description.narrative: In 2025, UNESCO has led the development, along with inputs from other members in the Technical Hub, of a dedicated data platform on Ukrainian learners, aiming to support the consolidation, analysis and presentation of various data sources, including access to education, policy and support measures of regional and national responses for the education of Ukrainian refugees, and to promote the dissemination and use of evidence. The data dashboard consolidates key data, policy and support measures and evidence on education Ukrainian refugees in European host countries. To ensure the data dashboard continues to serve partners‘ needs, there is a clear need to continue updating the database, refining the visualizations, and increasing the update and use of the data for policy, planning and programming.
